target.role: Director & Portfolio Manager, On Strategy Portfolio

summary: Multi-asset investment professional with ~7 years across portfolio analytics, model governance, and investment platform delivery, targeting Director & Portfolio Manager, On Strategy Portfolio - Toronto. Holds delegated sign-off on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio risk outputs for institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement at Moody's Analytics. Brings VaR/CVaR portfolio optimization and asset mix advisory from Ortec Finance, model governance committee membership, and delivery of all assigned client migrations onto the PFaroe PM portfolio management platform.
core_skills: Investment Platform Migration (Calypso to PFaroe PM)

sections.heading: Portfolio Analytics Oversight & Model Governance
bullets: Held delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio-level outputs for multi-asset institutional client portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before production release.
Served on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered portfolio analytics.
Validated derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, confirming sensitivity consistency at portfolio-aggregate level.

sections.heading: Process Controls, Risk Management & Escalation
bullets: Escalated outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility and acted as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls, supporting model-governance audit requirements.

sections.heading: Operational & Technology Change Delivery
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine covering base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, delivering forward-looking visibility across portfolio horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) supporting funding optimization, refinancing-risk assessment, and asset-allocation decisions.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection, driving process improvement that cut development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

sections.heading: Centre of Investment Expertise
bullets: Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative outputs into investment-committee-ready narratives.
Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms adopting PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms.
Migrated all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to PFaroe PM, validating model outputs post-deployment.
Translated investment-team requirements into scoped Product Owner requests and advised clients on asset, liability, and portfolio configurations.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Coordinated actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery, governance documentation, and regulatory-readiness processes.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk budgeting, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test the robustness of allocation recommendations.
Advised institutional clients on strategic and tactical asset mix trade-offs via stress testing and sensitivity analysis.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed market environments.
Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis weighing return objectives, duration alignment, and liquidity considerations for pension-fund clients.

Led the client onboarding and ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger, developing and validating the model as part of a three-person team - capturing all funding-policy dynamics and evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.
Presented study findings and allocation recommendations on-site to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
